profile_text.body:
GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. is a public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, trading under the ticker GEHC. Its SEC CIK number is 0001932393. The company also appears under the name GE HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY.

On its website, GE HealthCare describes itself as providing digital infrastructure, data analytics, and decision support tools for diagnosis, treatment and monitoring of patients. The company states it has over 130 years of delivering innovative solutions and tops the FDA's list of AI-enabled medical devices. It says it is helping transform the way hospitals and healthcare systems operate and empowering clinicians to make therapies more accurate and effective.

Public records list 374 legal matters in Illinois involving the company.
